name: openaddresses
what_it_holds: Global collection (14,515+ commits) of source manifests (CC0 JSON metadata) for address, cadastral parcel, building footprint and street-centerline datasets, with a `us-data/` tree covering many US counties/states; processed outputs downloadable from openaddresses.io. Source metadata CC0-1.0; repo code BSD-3; underlying data retains original licenses.
why_useful: A discovery/aggregation layer over hundreds of county and municipal parcel/cadastral data sources (many of which include building footprints and, indirectly, parcel counts usable as a housing-stock/permit-adjacent proxy) -- fills the 'county assessor/parcel data' item at national/international scale rather than one county at a time.
time_coverage: snapshot of current source data, updated periodically since project inception (~2014)
license: CC0-1.0 (source metadata); BSD-3 (code); original licenses for underlying data
themes: Housing supply and investor activity: building permits, Redfin investor purchases, mortgage rates, county assessor/parcel data, LLC ownership, NYC PLUTO/ACRIS
why_all: A discovery/aggregation layer over hundreds of county and municipal parcel/cadastral data sources (many of which include building footprints and, indirectly, parcel counts usable as a housing-stock/permit-adjacent proxy) -- fills the 'county assessor/parcel data' item at national/international scale rather than one county at a time.

name: GitHub topic: building-permits (index page, not a single repo)
what_it_holds: Index of 18 repos tagged building-permits, notably: OpenPermitFees (machine-readable US building-permit fee schedules with sourcing), Shovels API client/profile repos (claims 130M+ building permits across 1,800+ US jurisdictions, 2.3M+ contractor profiles -- paid API, not a free dataset), a Vancouver building-permits Dash exploration tool, a San Diego renovation-permit analytics repo, and a BuildData Canadian construction/real-estate API sample.
why_useful: Surfaces the closest thing to a national building-permit aggregator on GitHub (Shovels), and machine-readable permit-fee schedules (OpenPermitFees) that proxy local construction-cost/regulatory friction feeding into new STR/LTR unit supply -- worth flagging even though most are thin wrappers over paid APIs.
geography: primarily US, city/county level; one Canadian, one Vancouver-specific
time_coverage: varies; Shovels claims broad historical jurisdiction coverage (unverified, paid API)
last_activity: mixed, several recent (2026) per description tone
size_hint: Shovels claims 130M+ permit records nationally (behind paid API, not verified directly)
themes: Housing supply and investor activity: building permits, Redfin investor purchases, mortgage rates, county assessor/parcel data, LLC ownership, NYC PLUTO/ACRIS
why_all: Surfaces the closest thing to a national building-permit aggregator on GitHub (Shovels), and machine-readable permit-fee schedules (OpenPermitFees) that proxy local construction-cost/regulatory friction feeding into new STR/LTR unit supply -- worth flagging even though most are thin wrappers over paid APIs.

name: GitHub topic: parcel-data (index page)
what_it_holds: Index of 7 repos: CityOfDetroit/rental_map (registered-rental-property map for Detroit, Leaflet/ESRI), joshvern/citylens-web (NYC parcel intelligence + aerial/3D site analysis), Center-for-Land-Economics/civicmapper (land-value/improvement maps across 35+ cities, Python), property-boundary/property-boundary (PostGIS/GeoPandas cadastral ETL pipeline framework), pdiegel/NC-Parcel-Search (North Carolina parcel search webapp).
why_useful: CityOfDetroit/rental_map is a committed, city-published registered-rental-property dataset (STR/LTR host-supply proxy for a mid-size US market outside our current 13-city Inside Airbnb panel); civicmapper aggregates land-value data across 35+ cities and could be a cross-check for county assessor coverage.
size_hint: Detroit rental registry: city-wide; civicmapper: 35+ cities
themes: Housing supply and investor activity: building permits, Redfin investor purchases, mortgage rates, county assessor/parcel data, LLC ownership, NYC PLUTO/ACRIS

name: GitHub topic: hmda (index page)
what_it_holds: Index of HMDA-related repos, notably a described 'hmda_database' project (harmonized DuckDB build of 40+ years of HMDA mortgage data, 685M rows, one-command build) plus several fair-lending/disparity analysis repos (hmda-racial-disparities, CATE-HMDA-Heterogeneous-Effects, hmda-analyzer, fair-lending-screener, fairlens) built on public HMDA loan-level data.
why_useful: If the 'hmda_database' project (or an equivalent) is real and reproducible, a 685M-row, 40-year harmonized mortgage-origination panel in DuckDB would be a very strong national mortgage-rate/lending-volume time series for the housing-supply-economics gap; flagged as unverified since a direct repo fetch under the described owner/name 404'd and the exact URL could not be confirmed within budget.

name: housing-commute-analysis
what_it_holds: Reproducible pipeline integrating ACS socioeconomic/commute data, Zillow ZORI rent estimates, and OpenStreetMap transit features at the ZCTA level for Phoenix, Memphis, Dallas-Fort Worth, and Los Angeles, modeling rent burden and spatial equity.
why_useful: ZCTA-level rent-burden construction (ACS + ZORI) for 4 major US metros including two Inside-Airbnb-adjacent markets is a usable template for a tract/ZCTA rent-burden panel, addressing gap #13's host-economics angle in metros we already track supply for.
geography: Phoenix, Memphis, Dallas-Fort Worth, Los Angeles (ZCTA level)
size_hint: small repo (2 stars), reproducible pipeline not a bulk static dump
themes: Housing affordability and STR-housing studies data: rent-burden, vacancy, STR share of housing stock by tract
why_all: ZCTA-level rent-burden construction (ACS + ZORI) for 4 major US metros including two Inside-Airbnb-adjacent markets is a usable template for a tract/ZCTA rent-burden panel, addressing gap #13's host-economics angle in metros we already track supply for.
